patch_list: Debug search logging
Temporary diagnostic patch: logs search responses and failures to logcat.
Enable search landing recommendations
Turns on the "You may like" trending panel on the search landing screen.
Fix TikTok TV identity

Re-tags the search and profile requests with the TikTok TV app id, which those backends require, while the feed keeps the TikTok Lite id that it is only served under; empty risk-engine answers are retried.
Fix TikTok TV profiles
Sends profile-head and video-grid requests to the live TikTok Lite endpoints instead of the retired TV profile backend.
Nested comment replies
Shows a comment's reply count in the row and opens its replies in a SmartTube-style sub-pane on CENTER, with BACK returning to the comment list. Fully D-pad operable.
Play in background
Adds a More-pane Off / Only audio choice that keeps the current post playing when the TV app is backgrounded.
Playback speed
Adds 2x, 1.5x, 1x and 0.5x playback to the player's More pane, applied with the same TTVideoEngine.setPlaybackParams call TikTok Lite uses.
Remove feed ads
Drops the ad posts TikTok Lite puts in the feed, search, category and profile responses, which the TV app otherwise plays as ordinary videos.
Remove TV sidebar categories
Empties the TV category lists so the sidebar only shows Search, For You, and Following, like TikTok Lite.
Render Lite image posts
Shows the pictures of a TikTok Lite image post instead of a black player, which the TV app cannot render at all.
Render Lite subtitles
Adds the subtitles button to the player's floating row and draws the post's captions over the video, with SmartTube-style presets, size and position settings in the More pane.
Show TikTok Lite content
Reports the TikTok Lite app id on the wire and targets the live feed endpoint, so the server serves TikTok content instead of the retired TV feed.
Translate comments and captions

Adds TikTok's Aa translation panel to More — always translate comments, a do-not-translate list, the target language and also-translate-caption — and renders a dimmed "Translated from …" line under translated comments and above translated…
